solicitationText.description: Text of the solicitation's cover page and opening sections (for example SF 33 or SF 1449 and Section B)

solicitationId.description: Solicitation number exactly as written, e.g. 36C10B-27-R-0057, or '' if not stated

title.description: Short title of the requirement as the solicitation names it, or ''

agency.description: Issuing department or agency, e.g. Department of Veterans Affairs, or ''

office.description: Issuing contracting office from the 'Issued by' block, without the street address, or ''

contractType.description: Contract type and period of performance as stated, e.g. 'Firm-fixed-price task order, one base year and four option years', or ''

basisForAward.description: 'Best value tradeoff (FAR 15.101-1)' or 'Lowest price technically acceptable (FAR 15.101-2)' when the text says which, otherwise ''

openQuestions.description: Fields the text does not state or states inconsistently, for the Contracting Officer to fill in, or 'None'
